articles.summary: Measurable AI looked at individual subscription receipts for ChatGPT, Claude and Grok across ten markets from January through October 2026. ChatGPT reached the largest share of paying users in every market where we show payer reach, except Singapore.
articles.title: ChatGPT Leads Consumer AI Subscriptions

articles.summary: Shopee was the only one of three platforms in Measurable AI’s Southeast Asia e-receipt panel to record more Double 11 orders than a year earlier.
articles.title: A quiet Double 11 in Southeast Asia
